Now the full cohort analysis. I'll assemble it as a single query: index AF (first diagnosis), first anticoagulant per class within 90 days, pick earliest class as initial, then count patients with stroke/TIA and bleeding in the 90 days post-initiation.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH af AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS af_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
ac AS (
  SELECT de.person_id,
    CASE
      WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 21600962 THEN 'VKA'
      WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 21601019 THEN 'DTI'
      WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 43534760 THEN 'FXa'
    END AS drug_class,
    de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor anc ON anc.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE anc.ancestor_concept_id IN (21600962, 21601019, 43534760)
),
first_ac AS (
  SELECT af.person_id, ac.drug_class, ac.start_date AS tx_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY af.person_id ORDER BY ac.start_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM af
  JOIN ac ON ac.person_id = af.person_id
   AND ac.start_date >= af.af_date
   AND ac.start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, af.af_date)
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_class, tx_date FROM first_ac WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT drug_class, COUNT(*) AS n_patients
FROM cohort
GROUP BY drug_class
ORDER BY n_patients DESC

Cohort built: 13,337 patients initiating an oral anticoagulant within 90 days of first AF diagnosis. Now the outcome counts (stroke/TIA and bleeding in the 90 days after treatment initiation) per class.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH af AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS af_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
ac AS (
  SELECT de.person_id,
    CASE
      WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 21600962 THEN 'VKA'
      WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 21601019 THEN 'DTI'
      WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 43534760 THEN 'FXa'
    END AS drug_class,
    de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor anc ON anc.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE anc.ancestor_concept_id IN (21600962, 21601019, 43534760)
),
first_ac AS (
  SELECT af.person_id, ac.drug_class, ac.start_date AS tx_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY af.person_id ORDER BY ac.start_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM af
  JOIN ac ON ac.person_id = af.person_id
   AND ac.start_date >= af.af_date
   AND ac.start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, af.af_date)
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_class, tx_date FROM first_ac WHERE rn = 1
),
stroke_ids AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443454, 373503)
),
bleed_ids AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (192671, 439847)
),
stroke_pt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = c.person_id
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT cid FROM stroke_ids)
   AND co.condition_start_date > c.tx_date
   AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, c.tx_date)
),
bleed_pt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = c.person_id
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT cid FROM bleed_ids)
   AND co.condition_start_date > c.tx_date
   AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, c.tx_date)
)
SELECT c.drug_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) AS n_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.person_id) AS n_stroke_tia,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.person_id) AS n_bleed
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN stroke_pt s ON s.person_id = c.person_id
LEFT JOIN bleed_pt b ON b.person_id = c.person_id
GROUP BY c.drug_class
ORDER BY n_patients DESC

## 90-day outcomes by initial anticoagulant class in new-onset AF

Cohort: first-ever AF diagnosis with an oral anticoagulant started within 90 days; class = the earliest agent initiated. Outcomes = ≥1 event in the 90 days after treatment start.

| Initial class | Patients | Stroke/TIA n (rate) | Bleeding n (rate) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct factor Xa inhibitors (apixaban/rivaroxaban/edoxaban) | 10,365 | 698 (6.7%) | 393 (3.8%) |
| Vitamin K antagonists (warfarin) | 2,328 | 235 (10.1%) | 165 (7.1%) |
| Direct thrombin inhibitor (dabigatran) | 644 | 58 (9.0%) | 44 (6.8%) |
| **Total** | **13,337** | **991 (7.4%)** | **602 (4.5%)** |

**Observations**
- Factor Xa inhibitors were the dominant first choice (78% of initiators) and had the lowest 90-day rates of both stroke/TIA (6.7%) and bleeding (3.8%).
- VKA initiators had the highest event rates (stroke/TIA 10.1%, bleeding 7.1%), and DTI sat in between.

**Method & caveats**
- AF = SNOMED 313217 + descendants; classes = ATC B01AA / B01AE / B01AF descendants; stroke/TIA = cerebral infarction (443454) + TIA (373503) descendants; bleeding = GI hemorrhage (192671) + intracranial hemorrhage (439847) descendants.
- These are **crude, unadjusted** rates. VKA patients are typically older with more comorbidity (confounding by indication), so the higher VKA/DTI rates should not be read as causal — no adjustment, matching, or competing-risk/censoring for death or drug discontinuation was applied. Events are "any diagnosis record" (prevalent codes may be recaptured), and 90-day follow-up completeness was not verified.
